findings.finding: The validator computes the expected target/module subset but uses it only for the map count. Each entry's membership is then checked against the combined seven-source dictionary. It never requires the entry path to belong to that map's expected subset or to have the corresponding suffix.
findings.staticCounterexample: Starting with the complete synthetic fixture, replace the unselected ordinary target-map entry with the approved YamlCpp.Build.cs path and name YamlCp, the basename produced by the validator after removing ten characters for '.Target.cs'. The target-map count remains three, the name is unique, the path belongs to the combined approved source set, and the validator's calculated stem matches. The selected E04 target/module identities, source union, manifest, PDB associations and remaining joins can remain unchanged. No check in this function rejects that wrong-kind association.
findings.impact: The VALIDATED_FINITE_OWNED_PROCESS_RULES_POSTSTATE result can cover less than the required complete finite name-map association.
findings.requestedChange: Validate each map against its exact expected path subset, suffix and name mapping while retaining observed enumeration order. Add a pure rejection fixture for cross-category substitution.
findings.evidenceQualification: Static control-flow conclusion only; neither the implementation validator nor the fixture suite was executed.

findings.title: Required missing-manifest rejection control is absent
requirementCitations: reviewDiscipline.finiteRulesWitnessCriteria[7]: meaningful pure controls must cover missing PDB/manifest evidence
findings.finding: The suite tests a null PDB debug pair and divergent manifest source order, but has no missing-manifest control. Its generic missing-role case removes the first retention item, which is the DLL; it does not remove the manifest.
findings.requestedChange: Add explicit pure controls for absent manifest data and missing manifest retention/preservation evidence, retaining the existing positive complete join and primary-plus-secondary failure controls.
findings.qualification: Production missing-file and required-role guards exist. This finding concerns the explicitly required control coverage, not an observed native acceptance of a missing manifest.

substantiveAssessment.assessment: All 310 complete module-selector combinations were read with their occurrence mappings. Under expected Win64/x64 Editor Development, developer-tools=true and cooked-data=false conditions, 1737 of 1774 module occurrences are descriptor-eligible; 36 fail platform allow lists and one is Program-only. Thirteen duplicate module-name groups remain explicit; repeated descriptor entries are not additional module instances. For ordinary plugin candidates, 1550 references are eligible for a new instance, seven are disabled and three fail platform allow lists. Existing-instance handling precedes filters and was separately considered. The independent conservative runtime closure exactly matches the listed 245 plugins. The conditional descriptor build closure reaches 246: TcpMessaging and UdpMessaging lie outside the runtime closure, while LowLevelNetTrace is retained conservatively but excluded by its synthesized explicit empty platform list. These conclusions depend on expected live selectors and applicable discovery, not constructor defaults or actual execution.

substantiveAssessment.assessment: BuildPlugins serialization and optional-dependency filtering were distinguished from runtime enable roots. Receipt project/target/platform/configuration and Launch/LaunchCmd bindings, E04 override and engine-default policy were joined to wrapper checks and runtime consumers. Environment insertion precedes relevant parsing; the wrapper explicitly clears UE-CmdLineArgs and UE_ADDITIONAL_PLUGIN_PATHS. Complete Default startup dispatch propagates normal load failure. Normal dispatch excludes ExplicitlyLoaded plugins. Explicit mount defaults are ELoadingPhase::Max; the implementation iterates eligible phases but does not propagate every TryLoadModulesForPlugin failure through mount success. PluginUtils, Fab, Pak, GDK, GameFeatures and low-level-test callers were assessed with their finite gates. Neither mount success nor catalog membership establishes activation. The authored parser/probe entrypoints use FDefaultModuleImpl.
